Comments: Education services (school enrollment, university systems) are partly digitized with e-learning platforms. No documented evidence of learner registry or credential data integrated into the G2G data exchange platform for cross-government use.

revision_notes: Original sole source (sis.gov.eg) could not be accessed after repeated attempts (timeout) and so could not be verified. Definition: Integration of voter registration data for identity verification, demographic analysis, and service delivery targeting
Comments: No documented evidence of electoral register data integration with the G2G or Digital Egypt data exchange platform. Electoral registry managed by the National Elections Authority but cross-system integration with data exchange not confirmed.
redteam_note: Source is a dev/aggregator/off-topic domain — check it actually supports the score. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original source returned unreadable/corrupted content and does not support 'Unknown'. Verified evidence: NEA Law 2017 requires state agencies to share data with the Authority; a 2020 MCIT-NEA protocol links voter-database updates with Civil Registry and the Ministries of Justice, Health, Interior and Defence; the National Voter Database Project (since 2014) is built on the national ID number; and MCIT deployed hundreds of national ID e-readers linked to the NEA data centre for the 2024 presidential election. This is real, operational integration — revised up to 'Partially integrated' (4).

Definition: Integration of job seeker registries, unemployment insurance, public employment programs, labor market information
Comments: FORSA livelihoods programme (linked to Takaful/Karama) supports employment pathways but integration of formal employment/labor market registries into G2G exchange not documented.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Original source (Ahram Online interview on Takaful/Karama) discusses the cash-transfer programme, not employment services, and does not support this score. Fresher evidence (March-April 2026) shows the Ministry of Labour has launched an online 'Kaab El Amal' work-permit/job-seeker registration system tied to the National ID and is building a national jobs database, with a comprehensive digital labour-matching platform announced as imminent but not yet launched. Active development beyond mere planning — revised up to 'Under development' (3).

Definition: Integration of court records, case management systems, correctional services data, legal aid information
Comments: MCIT supported digital capacity development for law enforcement including Ministry of Interior, Public Prosecution, and court systems (13,493+ trained personnel). Litigation services being digitized. Specific integration of court records with G2G data exchange not fully confirmed.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Original sole source (sis.gov.eg) could not be accessed (repeated timeout). Verified sources confirm functioning integration: Economic Courts have run an end-to-end digital case-management platform (Dynamics 365) since 2020-22; a live G2G electronic link exists between the Public Prosecution's traffic division and Ministry of Interior traffic departments (no more paper clearance certificates); and by 2025 e-litigation was extended to criminal courts. This is operational, multi-agency linkage — revised up to 'Partially integrated' (4).

Definition: Integration of statistics, census data, administrative data for planning, M&E, and evidence-based policymaking
Comments: MPED launched the Bayan platform for national accounts data collection from ministries electronically. CAPMAS (Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics) manages national data. API integration for government entities and public data sharing is mentioned in Egypt Vision 2030.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed with fresher, better sources. Egypt adopted a National Open Data Policy in August 2025 as an interim framework 'pending the enactment of a data governance law', and the Ministry of Planning launched a Sustainable Development Goals Data Platform for Governorates that aggregates CAPMAS and ministry data. Active build-out but no fully integrated, legally-grounded national data exchange yet — 'Under development' (3) remains the best-supported code.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Egypt has a G2G system linking ~33,000 government institutions via a secured government network, and the Digital Egypt Portal (launched 2020) provides 175+ government services integrating multiple agencies. The system is partially operational with ongoing optimization. Some agencies still use siloed/paper-based systems.
redteam_note: Source is a dev/aggregator/off-topic domain — check it actually supports the score.
revision_notes: Confirmed. we.hse.ru returned unreadable/corrupted content and does not support the score; sis.gov.eg news URL could not be verified (timeout). Independent sources confirm the Digital Egypt/G2G platform is active and growing (210 services, 10.7m users in 2025, up from 170/8.1m in 2024) but not yet universal — the Cabinet is only proposing from 2026 to make some services exclusively digital, and many citizens still use in-person channels. 'Partially Operational' (4) remains well supported.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Government network links ~33,000 institutions across 27 governorates. Social protection system (Takaful/Karama) operates in all 27 governorates with 3,000+ offices. 311 technology centers operate across governorates. Digital Egypt portal accessible nationally, though urban areas more advanced.
redteam_note: Source is a dev/aggregator/off-topic domain — check it actually supports the score.
revision_notes: Confirmed, with better sources — the we.hse.ru and Ahram (Takaful) sources originally cited do not address sub-national data-exchange participation. Fresher evidence shows a governorate rollout still under way: 332 'Decent Life' service centres across 20 governorates only completed technology installation by end-2025, and as of March 2026 individual governorates (e.g. New Valley) are still building unified information networks linking HQ with administrative centres. Confirms partial, uneven sub-national participation — 'Partial Participation' (4) remains appropriate.
